_about: Post-quantum standards with the names a document might use for each. The eleven records with cascade: true are the Standards Cascade’s own, every identifier, title and status confirmed on its publisher’s page on 30 September 2026; the Cascade, the profiles’ standards rows and the documents’ notes read those only. The records with cascade: false belong to the Standards overview; each identifier, title, status and builds-on link was read at its body’s own source on 5 October 2026. buildsOn lists only standards a specification uses, quoted in provenance; a report that surveys other standards, or names them only in an informative bibliography, builds on none. bodyStatus gives the body’s own status words, a standards lifecycle kept apart from the legal lifecycle and from bindingness; bodyStatus and statusDate are null where no source the Atlas holds states them. Pre-standard names are the algorithm names used before a standard renamed them, or before a national standard exists; draft names are the Internet-Drafts an RFC was published from.
